string.name: permission_internet_reason
string.value: Network access is required to run MRP programs that support network communication

string.name: permission_vibrate_reason
string.value: Vibration motor is needed for touch haptic feedback

string.name: settings_desc_resolution
string.value: Set the emulator screen resolution. Takes effect on next launch. Different MRP apps may need their original device resolution.

string.name: settings_desc_memory
string.value: Memory size determines the heap space visible to MRP. Takes effect on next launch.

string.name: settings_desc_speed
string.value: Speed up game execution. 1x is normal speed, 4x is maximum. Can also be switched temporarily on the emulator page.

string.name: settings_desc_filter_ai_neural_full
string.value: This device supports Mali GPU hardware upscale (AI upscale). Selecting AI Upscale uses Mali neural network upsampling, with better quality than built-in FSRCNNX. Takes effect immediately.

string.name: settings_desc_filter_ai_spatial_full
string.value: This device supports Mali GPU hardware upscale (spatial upscale). Selecting AI Upscale uses Mali GPU spatial upsampling, with better quality than built-in FSRCNNX. Takes effect immediately.

string.name: settings_desc_filter_default
string.value: Original preserves pixel edges, Smooth blurs the whole image, Edge/Advanced AA only smooths diagonal lines and curves, AI Upscale uses FSRCNNX sharpening. Takes effect immediately.

string.name: settings_desc_screen_effect
string.value: Full CRT simulates a CRT TV (phosphor persistence + shadow mask + scanlines + barrel distortion), LCD Grid simulates old phone screen vertical stripes, Scanlines only adds scanline effect.

string.name: settings_desc_subpixel
string.value: Uses LCD subpixel RGB layout to improve text and edge clarity. Most effective on high-resolution screens.

string.name: settings_desc_gamma
string.value: Applies sRGB gamma curve before brightness/contrast/saturation adjustments to avoid color shifts. Recommended to keep on.

string.name: settings_desc_dither
string.value: Applies Bayer dithering when converting RGB565 to RGBA to reduce color banding. Recommended to keep on.

string.name: settings_desc_haptic_strength
string.value: Adjust haptic feedback intensity for key touches. Try it immediately after selecting.

string.name: settings_desc_gamepad
string.value: Customize gamepad key-to-MRP mapping. Supports stick directions and combo keys.

string.name: settings_desc_shake_intensity
string.value: Adjust vibration intensity triggered by mr_startShake in games. Gentle = short vibration, Strong = long vibration + alarm mode. Takes effect immediately.

string.name: settings_desc_sensitivity
string.value: Adjust accelerometer sensitivity multiplier. 1.0 is default. Higher values make the ball move faster in motion games. Requires game restart.

string.name: settings_about_desc
string.value: MRP Emulator is an app simulator based on the Mythroad platform, capable of running classic MRP mini-games and applications on HarmonyOS devices.

string.name: settings_desc_backup
string.value: Package games, saves, and cache as a zip file to the download directory

string.name: settings_desc_restore
string.value: Import files from a zip to the memory card (sandbox), overwriting existing files

string.name: settings_desc_import
string.value: Batch import .mrp game files to the memory card

string.name: dialog_msg_clear
string.value: This will delete all games, saves, and cache (including imported MRP files). Base resources will be restored on next launch. This action cannot be undone. Continue?

string.name: toast_cleared
string.value: Cleared. Restart the app to take effect

string.name: dialog_desc_backup_name
string.value: Will be saved as a zip file to the download directory. Files with the same name will be overwritten

string.name: dialog_msg_restore
string.value: Data will be restored from a backup file. Current games, saves, and cache will be overwritten. Continue?

string.name: toast_restore_ok
string.value: Restore successful. Restart the app to take effect

string.name: index_empty_hint_fav
string.value: Swipe left in Library to add favorites

string.name: settings_desc_dark_mode
string.value: Reduce blue light to protect your eyes

string.name: settings_desc_follow_system
string.value: Automatically follow system dark mode setting
